smoke.title: Cutter connection test
smoke.intro: This page cuts a 25 mm square to confirm the computer can talk to the cutter.
smoke.steps: Load a piece of vinyl, set force and speed on the cutter panel, set the origin, then click Connect cutter.
smoke.unsupported: This browser cannot talk to the cutter. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.

status.label: Status
status.lost: Disconnected: the cable was pulled or the cutter turned off.
status.sent: Sent. This shows what was sent, not what has been cut.

errors.busy: The port is in use by another program. Close other cutting programs and try again.
errors.lost: The cutter was disconnected. The app cannot lift the knife: press the pause button on the cutter panel.
errors.generic: Could not talk to the cutter.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.fixed: 8 data bits, 1 stop bit. Settings are locked while the port is open.
